actionTiming.rule: Action animation timing is authored and approved per action; it never inherits Fast Timing V1 merely because it follows a transition.
actionTiming.intent: Action animations should be entertaining to watch and may use slower cadence, anticipation, repetition and comic holds.

runtimeIntegration.reason: The versioned Prime runtime bank applies walk 10 fps, deceleration 12 fps and approved per-route stair cadence. Turns are installed at 16 fps and await the gameplay turn controller.
